high_level_description: This image is a screenshot from an Instagram post by the account "dailyphilosopher." The post features a portrait of William Blake, a renowned English poet, painter, and printmaker. The portrait is a dark, moody painting with a somber tone, depicting Blake seated and holding a quill pen, suggesting his role as a writer or artist. The text overlay on the image reads: "What is now proved was once only imagined." This quote is attributed to William Blake, and it is prominently displayed in white text against the darker background of the portrait.
